notes: I settled the axis_labels dispute after enlarging both ends of the axis. Only labels that are fully printed are listed, from 11.5 down to -1.0. Both image edges clip the axis labels. At the far left, a major tick sits at the image edge with only "2.0" visible under it. That is a clipped 12.0, inferred from the 0.5 ppm spacing. At the far right, the axis ends on a major tick after -1.0, and only "-1" is visible under it. That is a clipped -1.5, also inferred. These two partial labels are left out of axis_labels because their full values are not printed. The axis title is "f1 (ppm)", centered under about 5.5-5.0. The structure in the top-left is drawn with no compound number, title, frequency or solvent text. It shows a phenylalkyne, a CH2Ph (written "Ph") on a wedge bond, a 4-chlorophenyl and a vinyl group on a hashed bond. Integrals are green brackets below the baseline, with blue values rotated 90 degrees. I confirmed all six values after enlarging: 14.09 (about 7.3 ppm), 1.02 (about 6.35), 2.17 (about 5.2), 1.10 (about 3.45), 1.00 (about 3.2) and 2.08 (about 2.9). The last three are crowded together but readable. Short blue peak-pick ticks sit on the peak tops, but no ppm numbers are printed. Small peaks with no integral and no label are visible near 7.95, 1.55, 1.25 and 1.0 ppm. There are no insets.
